diagnoses: Initial guard used nonexistent view.copy; corrected to the existing public msv.tools.basic.copy route.
Current H5MSM 0.5 conversion explicitly rejects float_precision; use its public precision-preserving writer. Legacy 0.4 fallback requests double and remains inspected, not installed-qualified.

Quantity properties return fresh wrapper objects; wrapper identity caused repeated cold hashing. Cache is now keyed by stable system/domain identity/counts, with explicit invalidation after announced edits.
Full-run HDF5 close crashed while /tmp filesystem was exhausted. Relocated only this attempt's generated data; scoped recovery on repository filesystem passes.
contract_limits: Source SHA-256 binds saved ordered content; it does not authenticate declared original file origins.
Ordinary scene import keeps destination inventory on mismatched/absent binding or clear_first=False. Sessions refuse mismatch before replacing an existing destination.
Equal-count announced edits declare unchanged index order; explicit extraction remaps frame subsets/reorders.
Changed frame counts without correspondence mark frame maps unverified. Explicit append keeps old prefix correspondence; no original indices are invented for added frames.
Coordinate hashing has one cold O(atoms*structures) cost per system/announced edit and bounded chunk allocations. No additional long-lived trajectory or dense pair matrix is stored.
Benchmark traces additional Python allocations after coordinates are resident; no RSS, hard ceiling, H5MSM I/O throughput or published-provider claim.
